name: Off-Road Vehicle
description: A wheeled or tracked motorized vehicle designed or adapted for cross-country travel on natural terrain, dirt bikes and trail bikes included; an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria is one.

restrictions.rule: Designed or adapted for cross-country travel on land, water, snow, ice, marsh or other natural terrain; no limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicles Act, S.N.L. 2021, c. O-5.1, s. 2

restrictions.rule: Registered with the Registrar, with a plate or decal displayed; a first-time registrant must complete approved training
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicles Act, S.N.L. 2021, c. O-5.1, ss. 5 and 12

restrictions.rule: The operator and any passenger must wear a fastened helmet meeting CSA D230, FMVSS 218 or ECE 22.05, plus a face shield, glasses or goggles without an adequate windshield; the helmet may come off for hunting and trapping below 20 km/h
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicles Act, S.N.L. 2021, c. O-5.1, s. 20; Off-Road Vehicles Regulations, N.L.R. 30/22, ss. 9 and 10

restrictions.rule: Riders under 16 must have completed approved training, be supervised within sight by someone 18 or older with a driver's licence, and ride a machine sized for their age and weight
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicles Act, S.N.L. 2021, c. O-5.1, s. 22

restrictions.rule: A passenger only on a seat the manufacturer installed for one

On a highway only to cross it with 150 m of visibility, to ride up to 1 km on the shoulder at 20 km/h or less to reach a trail, or when weather has closed it to motor vehicles; the rider needs a driver's licence or supervision, and the vehicle insurance
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicles Act, S.N.L. 2021, c. O-5.1, s. 14; Off-Road Vehicles Regulations, N.L.R. 30/22, s. 6

restrictions.rule: Must yield to motor vehicles, pedestrians and cyclists on a highway
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicles Act, S.N.L. 2021, c. O-5.1, s. 14(4)

restrictions.rule: Municipal councils may allow it on municipal highways by regulation
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicles Act, S.N.L. 2021, c. O-5.1, s. 15
